_comment: Registry of the official documents behind each bundled band-plan pack. `npm run check:sources` re-fetches `check` URLs, hashes the normalised text (or PDF bytes) and compares with `sha256`; `--update` records new hashes after you have reviewed and rebuilt the pack. {today} in a URL is replaced by the current date, {ecfrDate} by the latest issue date the eCFR publishes for title 47.

sources.version: eCFR current to 2026-10-01; last amended 91 FR 1430-1431, 14 Jan 2026
sources.extraction: Fetched as XML from the eCFR versioner API, tags stripped, tables transcribed into scripts/build-packs.mjs (class access ranges, emission rows).
sources.gaps: Region 2 only; Novice class omitted; mode limits beyond 97.305 (97.307 emission standards) not reproduced.

sources.document: Radio Frequency Spectrum Regulations, Annexure I (Amateur radio frequency bands), as amended 2021
sources.extraction: HTML page tags stripped; table rows transcribed into scripts/build-packs.mjs. The 60 m row comes from ICASA's National Radio Frequency Plan 2018 as reported by ARRL/IARU Region 1 (not in this table).
sources.gaps: Third-party copy of the Gazette text, not ICASA's own site; a 2025 draft National Radio Frequency Plan and SARL submissions (Jan 2026) may change values — check ICASA and the SARL. Page text can include site boilerplate, so a CHANGED result may be cosmetic: diff before rebuilding.

sources.licence: German federal law (official work, no copyright)
sources.extraction: HTML tags stripped; the 45-row table parsed by column into scripts/pack-data/de-afuv-anlage1.json; footnote texts translated (unofficial) in scripts/build-packs.mjs.
sources.gaps: Row for > 275 GHz and the terahertz conditions (footnote 14) not listed.

sources.publisher: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
sources.document: RBR-4 Standards for the Operation of Radio Stations in the Amateur Radio Service, Schedule I
sources.extraction: PDF text via pdftotext -layout from a copy hosted by the University of New Brunswick (the ISED PDF itself was not fetched); Schedule I table transcribed into scripts/build-packs.mjs.
sources.gaps: Mirror, not ISED's own file; a newer ISED issue would not be detected by this hash — check the ISED page. 220-222 MHz and the 60 m single channels omitted.

sources.publisher: Australian Communications and Media Authority (Federal Register of Legislation)
sources.document: Radiocommunications (Amateur Stations) Class Licence 2023 [F2023L01648], Schedule 2 Table C (Advanced)
sources.extraction: PDF text via pdftotext -layout; Table C read from the text and transcribed into scripts/build-packs.mjs.
sources.gaps: The as-made PDF never changes, so amendments are NOT detected by this check: look at the instrument's compilations on the Federal Register of Legislation. Advanced class only; Tables A (Foundation) and B (Standard) not transcribed; bandwidth limitations not reproduced.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (総務省)
sources.document: アマチュア業務に使用する電波の型式及び周波数の使用区別 (令和5年総務省告示第80号) usage chart; power from the 'frequency etc. comprehensive display symbols' leaflet (June 2023)
sources.version: Last amended 令和7年7月17日総務省告示第259号
sources.licence: Japanese government publication (MIC terms of use)
sources.extraction: The chart is a picture: rendered to PNG (pdfplumber, 420 dpi), cropped per band and READ BY HAND; every boundary must be re-checked against the original. Power values read from the leaflet https://www.soumu.go.jp/main_content/000903134.pdf (rendered the same way).
sources.gaps: The notification's full text (tele.soumu.go.jp r05_80.pdf) returned an error page; bands above 10.5 GHz are not on the chart; overlay uses (repeater, VoIP, EME) are described in notes rather than as separate ranges.

sources.document: Ato nº 926, de 1 de fevereiro de 2024 — Requisitos Técnicos e Operacionais do Serviço de Radioamador
sources.version: Anatel page updated 5 Mar 2024; Anatel's June 2026 guide still cites it
sources.extraction: HTML page tags stripped; Tabelas II-XXIX parsed by cell into scripts/pack-data/br-ato926-subbands.json (the parser is described in the commit history); Table I (classes) and item 5 (power) transcribed into scripts/build-packs.mjs. The page counter 'Acessos' is removed before hashing.
sources.gaps: Ato 3448/2026 (11 Mar 2026) consolidates operational rules and exams and was not read; check whether it changes bands, classes or power. Repeater and IVG channelisation not reproduced. Anatel says the site text does not replace the Diario Oficial publication.

notIncluded.reason: Ofcom's licence documents are behind a bot-protection challenge (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare) that this project does not bypass.
notIncluded.needs: The current Amateur Radio Licence schedule (bands, power) or Interface Requirement IR 2028 as a PDF supplied by the maintainer.

notIncluded.reason: The DoT/WPC documents (G.S.R. 280(E) 2010 amending the Indian Wireless Telegraph (Amateur Service) Rules, with Annexure V bands and power) returned 404/403 or only scanned pages; a consolidated copy at arsi.info omits the annexure.
notIncluded.needs: A PDF of the current Annexure V (or the NFAP-2022 amateur rows) from DoT/WPC, supplied by the maintainer.
